# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 years old at the end of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c33 P46](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0046), [v1 c35 P15](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c38 P41](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0041)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with rosy cheeks, bright black eyes, and glossy black hair. She is described as having a plump, graceful figure with dimples in her cheeks. She dresses neatly and stylishly.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c33 P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 c33 P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Diana is good-tempered, friendly, and practical. She possesses a cheerful disposition, frequently laughing, and is a loyal and devoted companion. While she lacks the vivid imagination of her best friend, she appreciates creative stories and fun activities. She is obedient to her strict parents, though she occasionally engages in playful mischief.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c21 P19](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0019), [v1 c26 P11](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0011), [v1 c26 P18](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0018)_

## History

Diana meets Anne Shirley shortly after Anne arrives at Green Gables, and the two immediately swear an oath of eternal friendship in the Barry garden. They build a playhouse called Idlewild and spend their time playing games, sharing secrets, and exploring the outdoors. In the autumn, Anne accidentally serves Diana currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing Diana to become inadvertently intoxicated; as a result, Mrs. Barry forbids Diana from playing with Anne. The separation ends months later when Anne successfully treats Diana's younger sister, Minnie May, for a severe case of croup during an emergency. Later, Diana and Anne accidentally jump onto Aunt Josephine Barry in the spare bed during a sleepover following a Debating Club concert, but Anne manages to smooth over the situation with the elderly aunt. Diana participates in the school's story club and joins in dramatizing Tennyson's 'Elaine' on the pond, where Anne's boat leaks and nearly sinks. Though Diana does not join the Queen's preparation class because her parents do not intend to send her to college, she remains Anne's closest confidante and supporter throughout their teenage years.

## Background by volume

- Born to Mr. and Mrs. Barry of Orchard Slope in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- Named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her parents when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Raised in a strict household with a younger sister named Minnie May  <sub>[v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)</sub>

## Quotes

> Indeed I will, and I’ll never have another bosom friend—I don’t want to have. I couldn’t love anybody as I love you.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

> I love you devotedly, Anne, and I always will, you may be sure of that.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>
